summary: Static keyword hit on 'ping' in bundled UI asset; no exfiltration behavior corroborated
details: The package ships a bundled UI asset at dist/ui/app.js in which the token 'ping' appears multiple times on a single minified line. No code path reads installer secrets, environment variables, or filesystem contents, and no outbound network call to an attacker-controlled destination is present. The keyword co-occurrence matched by the rule is consistent with ordinary bundled UI code (e.g., WebSocket keep-alive 'ping'/'pong' messages or similar UI logic) rather than a command-execution or exfiltration path. No install-time or import-time side effects, no lifecycle scripts fetching remote content, and no credential-handling behavior were observed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
